description: The plot illustrates the performance of knowledge probing after editing with different editing methods on Llama2. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number", has a logarithmic scale, and ranges from 3 to 3000 with tick labels at 3, 10, 100, and 1000. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)", has a linear scale, and ranges from 60 to 80 with tick labels at 60, 65, 70, 75, and 80. There are six lines in the plot, each representing a different editing method: Base (black, circle marker, solid line), FT (blue, square marker, solid line), IKE (red, triangle marker, solid line), MEND (brown, diamond marker, solid line), MEMIT (purple, plus marker, solid line), and ROME (green, cross marker, solid line). The Base line starts at around 67% and ends at around 70%, increasing steadily across the x-axis. The FT line starts at around 66% and ends at around 69%, also increasing steadily. The IKE line starts at around 72% and ends at around 77%, showing a more significant increase. The MEND line starts at around 73% and ends at around 77%, with a similar trend to IKE. The MEMIT line starts at around 74% and ends at around 78%, increasing steadily. The ROME line starts at around 73% and ends at around 79%, showing the most significant increase among all lines.
